title.narrative: GUYANA - Education for All - Fast Track Initiative

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to support the Recipient in attaining the goal of universal primary school completion for girls andboys by the year 2015 through the EFA-FTI, and particularly through the implementation of the Guyana EFA-FTI Proposal, which is part of the Recipient's Endorsed Education Sector Plan.
